title: Tiago Guedes’ ‘Aquí’ wins the Coveted Golden Peacock for Best Film at 57th IFFI
subtitle: Jury applauds the film’s ability to evoke a profound sense of belonging within an unpredictable, dreamlike world
body_text:
Posted On: 28 NOV 2026 8:37PM by PIB Mumbai Release ID: 2343233 Views: 102 A A Print Share X Facebook Instagram WhatsApp Copy Article Link
Read in: English हिन्दी Urdu
Goa, 28 November 2026 The Portuguese-French film Aquí , directed by Tiago Guedes and produced by Paulo Branco, has won the Golden Peacock for Best Film, the highest competitive honour at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI). Director Tiago Guedes received the award at the festival’s closing ceremony in Goa. Chief Minister of Goa, Dr. Pramod Sawant, and Jury Chairperson, Shri Aanand L. Rai, jointly presented the award. The 204-minute co-production emerged as the winner among 15 films in the Main International Competition. After its premiere at the Cannes Film Festival in May 2026, the film travelled to the São Paulo International Film Festival and Jakarta Film Festival before adding the Golden Peacock to its international festival journey. The jury recognised the film for creating a comforting yet unpredictable cinematic universe, where uncertainty and a sense of belonging coexist. It also paid tribute to the late Manolo Solo, the film’s leading actor, acknowledging his enduring artistic legacy. “The film transports us into a comforting and dreamlike universe that, despite its unpredictability, feels like one we belong to and don’t wish to leave. The Jury would also like to honour the leading actor, the late Manolo Solo, whose legacy will be fondly remembered,” the jury observed. The Golden Peacock for Best Film recognises outstanding cinematic excellence in the Main International Competition. The award carries a cash prize of ₹51 lakh, shared equally between the director and producer. The director receives the Golden Peacock trophy and a certificate, while the producer receives a certificate, in addition to their respective shares of the prize money. Synopsis of ‘Aquí’ : In a world where people begin anew without memories of their past, Simón takes a young boy, David, under his care. Convinced that the child needs a mother, he finds Inés, and the three gradually form an unconventional family. As David’s curiosity and independent spirit bring him into conflict with a society that demands conformity, Simón and Inés must confront the uncertainties of parenthood and learn to embrace the child’s individuality.
